title: Two Attackers, One Guard
setup: Your queen on h5 and bishop on c4 both stare at f7, the square only the black king defends.
hint: Two of your pieces already hit the same square. Count how many black defenders it has.
explanation:
## The Idea

f7 is defended by the king alone, and two attackers beat one defender. {{Qxf7#}} lands beside the king, guarded by the bishop on c4, so it cannot be taken. e7 and f8 are covered by the queen itself; d7 and d8 are blocked by Black.
